rest.$description: Track of a switch that is off.

hover.$description: Track of a switch that is off, on hover.

pressed.$description: Track of a switch that is off, while pressed.

content.$description: Thumb of a switch that is off, in every state but disabled.

border.$description: Outline of the track of a switch that is off, so the control is visible on the page and on a surface.

rest.$description: Track of a switch that is on: the inverse fill, as on a primary button.

hover.$description: Track of a switch that is on, on hover.

pressed.$description: Track of a switch that is on, while pressed.

content.$description: Thumb of a switch that is on, in every state but disabled.

surface.$description: Track of a disabled switch that is off.

content.$description: Thumb of a disabled switch that is off.

border.$description: Outline of the track of a disabled switch that is off.

surface.$description: Track of a disabled switch that is on: filled, so on still reads apart from off.

content.$description: Thumb of a disabled switch that is on.
Label of a switch. Disabled, it takes switch/disabled/off/content.

text.$description: Label text style of a switch.

height.$description: Height of a switch's track, also the smallest target WCAG 2.5.8 allows; the label adds to the target.

size.$description: Width and height of a switch's thumb.

inset.$description: Space between the thumb and the track's edge: (track height − thumb size) ÷ 2.

gap.$description: Space between a switch's label and its track.

radius.$description: Corner radius of a switch's track and thumb: a pill in every shape, as the native switches on Android and iOS are.

border-width.$description: Outline width of a switch's track, reserved as a transparent border when it is on, so the box is the same.
